findings.claim: Pre-commit review found hyperlink index reuse after RIS could alias old cells and cache entries to new destinations; exact head fixes it.
findings.evidence: Table reset moved to host init and a real-WASM RIS regression passes.
findings.path: Terminal.reset -> hyperlink table -> WasmBridge link cache and scrollback

findings.claim: Pre-commit review found malformed or truncated OSC 8 input preserved a previous active link; exact head clears it.
findings.evidence: Active-link malformed and oversized payload regressions pass and parser force-red fails.

findings.claim: Pre-commit review found plain clicks could both emit SGR mouse input and navigate; exact head suppresses navigation while tracking.
findings.evidence: DOM event regressions prove plain click is prevented and Shift-click remains available.
findings.path: InputHandler mouse tracking -> WTerm click handler -> anchor default action

findings.claim: Pre-commit review found failed hyperlink-buffer growth could decode from WASM address zero; exact head returns undefined.
findings.evidence: Post-growth zero-pointer guard is present and the complete Ghostty suite passes.

findings.claim: The parallel cursor E2E can return a null bounding box immediately after visibility succeeds.
findings.evidence: The failure occurs before typing; full E2E passes 12/12 with one worker.

findings.claim: Ghostty hyperlink metadata cache is not pruned with scrollback rollover.
findings.evidence: The cache is keyed per semantic link and only cleared on init.
